column1: # Path map for the 2026-09-13 specification bundle.
# MANIFEST.sha256 records sha256 digests against the paths the bundle was delivered
# with. The repository restructure (blueprint §2.3) relocated some of those files.
# scripts/provenance-check.sh resolves each manifest line through this map and verifies
# the digest at the current path, proving no delivered byte was lost or altered.
# Files marked in-place are FROZEN CONTRACTS: editing them breaks the manifest, and the
# only legitimate change is an ADR that re-freezes under a new dated bundle directory.
